raw_record.original_question:
读“甲、乙两地某类企业单位产品成本构成和市场价格图”。

<image1>

关于该类企业转移，这种转移对转入地产业结构会产生什么影响？
raw_record.answer: Promote the optimization and upgrading of the industrial structure of the place it transfers into
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: The chart compares the market average prices and various cost compositions of unit products of a certain type of enterprise in places A and B in 2001 and 2011. By 2011, the market average prices in places A and B were roughly similar, but the labor cost in place A was significantly higher than that in place B, and the cost pressure of unit products in place A was greater; place B had lower labor costs and had a cost advantage.
Then reason: Because the profit space of this type of enterprise in place A is compressed, it is more likely to transfer from place A, where costs are higher, to place B, where costs are lower. After enterprises transfer into place B, they will drive the development of production departments, employment, and related supporting industries, and enhance the local secondary industry and industrial-chain supporting capacity, so it is beneficial to the optimization and upgrading of the industrial structure of the place it transfers into.
